rules.labelEn: Track eligibility and international study arrangements
rules.noteEn: Organisational Psychology accepts local and international applicants. Forensic Psychology is restricted to Singapore citizens/PRs; international applicants are not eligible for it. The unresolved parent choice must not inherit one track condition across both. Nationality, residence and Student Pass approval are not verified by the profile or by a fee quote. International graded coursework and PSY501/502/599 must be completed within the first two years; remaining self-sourced hours in years three/four in the country of residence require prior programme approval.

For international Organisational applicants whose first language or undergraduate instruction medium is not English, the page lists IELTS strictly above 6.5 with each subscore at least 6, internet TOEFL strictly above 85 with writing at least 22, or PBT above 580 with preferred TWE 5. Do not apply this unconditionally to every track/applicant, turn preferred TWE into a minimum, convert TOEFL scales or assume test expiry not stated here. SUSS must confirm the applicant category and accepted evidence.

University ELPR separately depends on undergraduate university medium and instruction language, with IELTS Academic at least 6.5, internet TOEFL 85, PTE 58, C1 180 within two years or MUET Band 4 within five years. General alternatives do not silently replace the international Organisational conditions. No automatic waiver or universal IELTS expiry is inferred.

Academic transcripts, CV and a personally written statement of interest of at most one page are required. Shortlisted applicants must attend interviews. The current MPSY checklist is separate from the Clinical reference-letter block; those requirements are not inherited. Incomplete applications are not considered. The platform does not collect, write, verify or submit these documents.

Attendance, assessed participation and substantial weekday business-hour practicums/workshops/supervision are compulsory. Local work-study feasibility needs careful scheduling; employment or overseas placements are not promised. Completing in two years normally requires a full-time commitment, without establishing every offered mode. Verify track and approved placement arrangements before relying on the timetable.

The 60-CU master requires award CGPA 3.0/5 and 1000 practicum hours, approximately 500 in PSY501/502/599 plus 500 self-sourced. These are study requirements, not pre-entry work hours. PSY534 is required for Forensic but excluded from Organisational electives; it does not make MPSY the separate Clinical degree. Professional preparation is not an automatic registration or overseas practice guarantee; external rules were not independently checked.

MOE annual/module-based rates, starred track quotes and self-funded PRCPSY costs have distinct applicability. Prior government graduate funding and the applicable cohort/category require review; do not grant a subsidy from citizenship alone, add diploma/bridge quotes automatically or infer Forensic international eligibility from a price column. Personal totals and PDF column/unit reconciliation remain unresolved.

rules.noteEn: Prepare certificate/transcripts, CV using the prescribed online form and a one-page statement. Two referee reports are required: one academic and one supporting professional/clinical skills, sent directly by referees within two weeks of application. Organisation endorsement applies only when relevant and is additional to the reports; the same person may provide both with distinct purposes. Shortlisted applicants attend face-to-face selection interviews; incomplete applications are not considered. The platform does not collect, write, contact referees or submit these materials.

International applicants are welcome subject to the Clinical criteria and a valid Student Pass. The ordinary MPSY Forensic citizen/PR restriction does not apply by inheritance. Neither eligibility nor an immigration decision or fee category is established by self-reported academic scores.

Clinical is two years full-time with no current part-time option. Classes are mostly during weekday business hours with some weekday evenings; three compulsory placements are mostly in business hours. Combining employment may be challenging; this is not a published blanket employment prohibition or promise of online-only/remote study.
